content:
Apple today released a new version of its "Apple Invites" app for iPhone. This update introduces new features from iOS 27, including enhanced photo sharing capabilities and improvements to Image Playground.

Here is Apple's full release notes for "Apple Invites" today:

  • Shared albums now support full-resolution sharing, allowing you to relive every moment in stunning detail within the app. Anyone can join and share photos, even users without an Apple device.
  • Image Playground can now help you create high-quality backgrounds in various styles, including ultra-realistic options, so your invitations can perfectly capture the atmosphere you desire.
  • Guests who need to verify their email can now simply tap a link in their inbox to complete the process, eliminating the need to enter a verification code and making it easier to attend events.
  • This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements.

You can download "Apple Invites" from the App Store. Creating invitations requires an iCloud+ subscription, but anyone can reply to an invitation.
